pairs.why: Both are close, but B's tilted-down plate view and soft dewy finish come slightly nearer to the real card's look, though B's glass is a touch glossier.
A has calmer colour and a softer finish, while B is oversaturated, glossy and crowded with droplets.
The two are nearly equal; A's colour masses (watermelon on the left, orange in front, grapes behind) and its soft finish match the real card a little better.
Both are rounded orange lockers; A's chunky soft body and warm orange read slightly more like the real toy-like locker.
A has the real card's thick, rounded, chunky body and soft shading, while B is flatter and boxier.
B is a thin-edged, realistic sheet-metal locker, while A keeps the soft, puffy, rounded build of the real card.
B's duck has a softer, calmer, less plastic-glossy finish and closed beak, closer to the real card's restrained look; A is more saturated and polished.
